fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.description: The folder to list, e.g. /news-and-insights/blog. Pages below it are listed newest first.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Optional. Limits the list to pages whose Category metadata matches this exactly.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Cards Per Page
fields.description: How many to show before the Load More button appears.
